description: LGA Unemployment Dashboard is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications and the Arts (DITRDCA). This interactive dashboard presents unemployment rate estimates for Local Government Areas (LGAs) alongside corresponding state/territory and national figures. Estimates are available from 2010 through to 2023. The Regional Data Hub created this dashboard from two existing data sources. LGA estimates were sourced from the Small Area Labour Markets (SALM) dataset created by Jobs and Skills Australia. Coverage is Australia, 2010 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
